# Fixture provenance

`upstream-kiro-pro-plus-usage.json` is copied unchanged from Pulse commit
`3696a65b428272aa25c3ba611de8df2536983515`, path
`Tests/PulseTests/Fixtures/kiro-pro-plus-usage.json`.
Its Git blob is `1ed264da622f6f4b80a76d957f2cb863642542a4`.
The fixture uses a future reset date (`2099-10-01`); no Windows account
response was captured in this port. Parsing tests fix their observation time.
Synthetic edge cases in `tests/kiro.rs` vary these documented fields only.

Source: <https://github.com/qunqin24/Pulse/blob/3696a65b428272aa25c3ba611de8df2536983515/Tests/PulseTests/Fixtures/kiro-pro-plus-usage.json>.
